Manipulate the Zealots
Unique Master
2

Put this card in play. Add a counter to this card during your untap phase. Any minion may burn all counters on this card as a  action.

Messages.Author: Molloy
Messages.Body:
design intent:

You can't just make a card that just hoses the Bahari. Such a card is neither necessary nor worth playing.

This is intended to be slightly better than a hunting ground, to make it worth playing, with an additional anti-Bahari function that, since Lilith's Blessing is currently the only relevant Bahari thing, is most harmful to Bahari low on blood.

What I read about the Bahari suggests they are not too far from the Sabbat in their habits, and that a savvy Sabbat elder might be able to manipulate the massochistic tendencies of the Bahari. Plus, word around the watercooler is that Sabbat titles ain't worth what they ought to be.

I don't think the escalating blood gain is that big a deal. It just means somebody needs to burn the counters every three turns or so. That encourages interaction between players. If it's too much, all it takes is a little amending.

Put this card in play. During your untap phase, add a counter to this card if it has fewer than three counters. During your master phase you may tap this card to add X blood to a ready Sabbat vampire and inflict X damage on each ready Bahari vampire, where X is the number of counters on this card. Any minion may burn all counters on this card as a  action.

or

Put this card in play. Add a counter to this card during your untap phase. During your master phase you may burn X counters from this card to add X blood to a ready Sabbat vampire and inflict X damage on each ready Bahari vampire. Any minion may burn all counters on this card as a  action.

Sabbat. Animals, Wraiths and Zombies Molloy recruits or employs get an additional life.

> I don't think the escalating blood gain is that big a deal. It just means somebody needs to burn the counters every three turns or so. That encourages interaction between players. If it's too much, all it takes is a little amending.

Well, part of the problem is that it help defend itself - if you gain 3 blood per turn on one of your vampire, he may be able to stop each and every burn attempt. The quintessential problem being Faerie ward.

Also, even with the new version, at max power it's a lillith blessing per turn, without condition. So there is some kind of being worse than the original problem.

You may stick to the 1 blood / turn, but make the hunting ground cheaper ?
